# MineLights Server 2.4.1

This update improves how MineLights Server prepares the native libraries used by hardware integrations.

## Changes

- Verify each embedded native library before use and replace a stale or unexpected cached copy.
- Keep native libraries in version- and content-specific folders so server updates do not reuse an older library.
- Protect the native-library cache used when the server runs as administrator, and reject unsafe cache paths.
- Add checks for corrupted caches, concurrent extraction and the paths passed to hardware providers.

The server's V2 protocol and existing client pairing remain unchanged.
